idea-plugin.name: MultiAgent
idea-plugin.description: Multi-agent chat over a local LLM server, in a JetBrains IDE tool window. Connects to Lemonade, any OpenAI-compatible server, or a native Ollama server. The core (LLM clients, workspace tools, orchestrator, persistence) is a deliberate fork of the desktop-java client - the two projects are kept independent.

action.description: Phase-0 spike: open ConversationStore under the plugin config dir and round-trip a row.
